text:
deploy-bot: Deploy kickoff: embed-service v2026-03-20 -> v2026-03-21. Canary 10% now routing. Change window 03:00-05:00 UTC. Watch SLOs and 5xx.

maria: watching dashboards :eyes: — p50 fine, p95 creeping up for embed-route (3s -> 4.1s) but only in canary nodes so far.

sam: can you drop the SLO dashboard link? I want the error heatmap.

maria: https://console.redwood/slo/embed-service?range=5m — error-rate panel + per-region breakdown.

raul: run this quick query on logs to see error classes:
```
filter service=embed-service status>=500 | count() by status, node, _minute | sort desc
```

alexa: seeing repeated 502s from quantize-worker-3 in eu-west, looks like a kernel OOM on that pod. :grimacing:

oncall-bot: ALERT: embed-route 5m error-rate = 0.92% (SLO threshold 0.8%) — triggered at 4923456810. Pager suppressed (deploy window).

sam: reduce canary to 0% and pin traffic back to v2026-03-20? Prefer no full rollback until we confirm.

maria: agree. I'll scale canary to 0% and pin the prior revision. Running command:
```
/deploy traffic-shift --service=embed-service --to=rev=v2026-03-20 --percent=0 --grace=30s
/deploy pin-version --service=embed-service --version=v2026-03-20 --reason="canary 5xx spike"
```

deploy-bot: Accepted. Traffic shift started: 10% -> 0% over 30s. Pin request queued.

alexa: after shift completes, can we keep an isolated canary node for postmortem? need core dumps from quantize-worker-3.

maria: yes — preserving pod logs and core. I've toggled retain=true for the canary node.

oncall-bot: NOTE: Alert remains open until error-rate <0.5% for 2 consecutive 5m windows.

sam: quick check: any rollout hooks that might have changed kernel params? raul — you touched quantize flags in the image?

raul: I added an LLM-quant flag flip but only on canary image. Rolling back should remove it. sending diff:
```
- argv += ["--quantize-kernel-experimental"]
+ (removed for stable)
```

alexa: good catch. that flag can increase memory pressure for long sequences.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift complete. Canary percent=0. Pin successful: service=embed-service pinned->v2026-03-20 by maria.

oncall-bot: ALERT RESOLVED at 4923456840 — error-rate dropped to 0.34% over last 5m. Incident cleared, but keep postmortem.

maria: filing a short postmortem and release note update: will add a paragraph about experimental kernel flag and add a canary checklist item to validate OOM-sensitive knobs.

sam: also add to release notes: "v2026-03-21 reverted from canary due to elevated 5xx on embed-route; pinned to v2026-03-20 while we investigate." Keep change window log.

raul: I'll open a PR to remove the experimental flag from the canary image and add memory ceiling stats to our perf tests.

alexa: thx — we should consider a preflight that runs a short long-sequence stress test before canary traffic. :+1:

maria: agreed. closing thread once PR and postmortem links are in the release task.

sam: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
